note: Burned-in identifier masks applied to the PACS starter bundle. Rectangles are (x0,y0,x1,y1) in native frame pixels, blacked out on EVERY frame of the named series. Categories only: the literal strings removed are deliberately not recorded here, because writing them down re-creates the disclosure the masking exists to undo.
method: Per series: max-projection over every frame (burned-in text changes within a loop, so frame 0 is not the region); visual review; mask; re-project the masked output and confirm peak luminance inside each box is noise, not glyphs.

abnormal/echo_stress_exercise.layout: 2x2 montage, boxes relative to each pane origin

preserved: View labels (LAX/SAX/AP4/AP2), REST/PEAK stage, heart rate, ECG strip, depth, probe, MI/TIS, timers — clinical and technical annotation carries no identity and is needed to read the study.
outOfScope: Non-US modalities in this bundle (CR, CT, DX, MG, MR) are not burned-in-annotation risk modalities per burnedInAnnotationRisk().
